race.comment: FOREST KING (4) returned for his second prep with a struggling sixth over 1200m at Rosehill on the heavy (9) surface on July 18. Finds a suitable race on the firmer surface and the blinkers go on. Leading contender. ZUBBA STORM (2) undefeated in two starts since joining the Mack Griffith yard. Anchored with the 60.5kg when he rounded them up with ease to salute over 1000m at Gunnedah.  Jumps in grade and trip and can play a leading role from the inside gate. BETTER LATE (6) gelded over the break and worth noting his two wins have come first-up. Primed for this with the two slick trial wins and ticks plenty of boxes with Ash Morgan aboard. ONMALONE (7) won well first-up and struggled in his two runs since. At his top for this and ticks a few boxes from the inside gate. Improver.
